A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we present a new geometric graph model, called multi-column graph, and formulate two combi-natorial optimization problems called optimal net surface problems, on these multi-column graphs, and present polynomial time algorithms for two special cases of these problems, and show how to apply these algorithms to some important applied problems such as surface reconstruc-tion in 3-D or 4-D, medical image segmentation in 3-D, and metric labeling in 4-D.

we have developed a new geometric graph called multi- column graph in the d-dimensional space (d?3) and formulated two combinatorial graph optimization problems on such graphs that capture some important problems in surface reconstruction, medical image segmentation and metric labeling.
we have presented polynomial time solutions to a number of important applied problems that have not been solved before.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the multi-column graph model is a useful tool to study a number of applied problems in computer science and other areas.
